info.title: shinydocdb - a terminal front end for Shiny.DocumentDb stores
info.description: A terminal front end for Shiny.DocumentDb stores - browse and edit documents, run SQL, manage JSON indexes, diff history, inspect geometry, blobs and vectors. Same admin layer and same connection profiles as the web front end, without a browser or a container.

options.name: --profile
options.description: connection to open (name match is case-insensitive)

options.name: --data-dir
options.description:
where the tool keeps its own state
(default ~/.shinydocdbmyadmin, same as the web front end)

options.name: --no-ai
options.description: run without the assistant, and without registering it

options.name: --no-splash
options.description: skip the Shiny mark on startup

options.name: --secrets
options.description:
include secrets in an export, encrypted under a passphrase
you are prompted for. Left out by default: an export that
carries connection strings is a credential file.
